name: Coolify Deployments
author: Peter Szarvas
description: Ongoing and last finished Coolify deployments, right in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Watch deployments. Configure your instance and read-only token in the panel.

schema.label: Refresh in background
schema.description: Poll Coolify every 30 seconds, or every 5 seconds during deployments.

schema.label: Watched application UUIDs
schema.description: Comma-separated UUIDs. Leave empty to watch every application visible to the token.

schema.label: Deployment notifications
schema.description: Notify when deployments start, succeed, fail or are cancelled. Automatic detection requires background refresh.
